items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions Ravel only in response to the interviewer's prompt 'How about Ravel?' and lists Ravel's works (e.g., 'Afternoon of a Faun') as music they listened to, but provides no evidence of personal interaction, meeting, or professional collaboration with Ravel himself.
